violations.text: All food in the prep unit was observed held between 45-51 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Prep unit ambient was observed at 54 DF at the time of inspection. Per PIC all food was stored in the walk-in cooler overnight and placed into the prep unit 2.5 hours prior to inspection. All food in prep unit was moved to the walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in prep unit until it is able to hold an ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The door to the outside, located in the lounge main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Establishment installed a door sweep, but a gap was still observed. Establishment is to ensure that the door is tight-fitting. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Chicken wings, which were prepared in advance, were not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Chicken wings were observed between 46-48 DF and voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

Various food was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment is to indicate all foods on menu that can be served raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

ROP lobster was observed thawing with ROP packaging still intact. Lobster was observed at 33 DF and completely removed from packaging at the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed with PIC. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

The door to the outside, located in the lounge main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

Beverage tubing was observed in contact with ice used for drinks at the bar. Beverage tubing and cold plate beverage cooling devices must not be in contact with stored ice. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026
The 3-bay sink faucet was observed with tape and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

-The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the kitchen dishwasher -The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the bar 3-bay sink -The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the bar. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels, and both test strips New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the 4 door stack fans, 4 door stack shelves, prep unit shelves, and ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

The floor under the equipment in the kitchen area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026
